study.question: Can evaluation dispatch of four independent task readouts be batched without losing click AUC, and does batching affine maps, frozen Dice gates, or their combination lower measured prediction cost at unchanged learned capacity?
study.hypothesis: Observed limitation: halving tower width lost about 0.001297 click AUC relative to the frozen joint entry, and embedding12 lost about 0.002642. Reallocating residual capacity reached 0.66712494, but aux6/click17 and tied projection branches did not improve on that parent; shared_reuse fell to 0.66482487. These bounded reductions and failures do not establish universal capacity necessity. Evaluation-only affine and Dice rewrites were more promising: the latest serial parent has AUC0.6671410169523699, p50/p95 whole-batch model latency15.198290348052979/15.350691974163055ms, validation inference25.108002692461014s, train314.2192954868078s and 32108245 parameters. Its contemporary original-Dice control had AUC0.6671356857671729 and p50/p9515.473917126655579/15.546974539756775ms; scorer-only/tower-only p50 were15.281997621059418/15.467651188373566ms. These are single-seed implementation observations, not established speedups or mechanism repetition. Source inspection shows the remaining four independent towers still dispatch the same-shaped operations serially. Batching dispatch can preserve each learned task function while reducing launches; independent channel packing preserves frozen Dice moments. Any benefit may be offset by copies, altered layouts or BF16 kernels. No capacity reduction or architectural novelty is claimed.

nearest_work.difference: Resolved and read the complete pinned primary source, commit90bb99a60724e975ec565836266fd86dcad0039d, SHA256 a956a5b1836b3ba5552a910314960094be644d45112ffc0ab3e7799f701ddc3c. Lines25-33 specify BatchNorm1d(affine=False,eps=1e-9,momentum=0.01), per-channel alpha and sigmoid mixture. Retain these statistics, epsilon and the parent mixture expression; concatenate independent channels for evaluation dispatch only. No training population pooling.

Read archived primary text, content5fee25f33f375e51b3ee9417d376ff9dbe2ea3628c932a7679ddfeb0feaaade2, especially section5.2 lines317-332. Inherit local activation and Dice. This experiment concerns scheduling four adapted benchmark heads, not a new interest mechanism, original-paper reproduction, or DIN performance transfer.

Resolved the complete validation receipt and read its available source; candidate.py initially matches SHA256 d7805c62e511952ee2996cf7eed790b9843894b3b0787a6648e252c64b1782b8. Inherit all training and learned functions, affine hoisting and mixture factoring. The sole new intervention is evaluation task dispatch.

Read the negative receipt: shared auxiliary projection/reuse changes learned parameter ownership and reached AUC0.6648248738234025. Here every task keeps its own weights, biases and Dice statistics; temporary stacking performs no tying, detachment or common learned prefix. This is not another test of shared representation capacity.

study.proposed_difference: Four standalone modules form a 2x2 factorial. joint_batch_reference.py is a byte-identical parent. joint_batch_affine.py batches the independent task Linear maps with torch.baddbmm on [tasks,batch,width] and stacked live weights/biases. joint_batch_dice.py concatenates [batch,task_channels] and corresponding running_mean/running_var/alpha, calls functional.batch_norm(training=False,momentum=0,weight=None,bias=None,eps=original), applies the inherited factored mixture and splits channels. candidate.py combines both as joint_batch_both. All cells retain separate final sigmoid outputs in label order. Evaluation collects the same task features before dispatch; residual maps are still independent and serial. Derived tensors are local to each call. Constructor modules, state-dict keys, RNG, host loss, masks and training tensor operations remain unchanged. Source comparison recovers the exact inherited constructor/forward after removing only new configuration checks, Python list collection and evaluation-only dispatch. No external architecture mechanism is imported.
predictions: Predeclared screening preservation rule: candidate full-population validation click AUC minus the contemporary serial control is at least -0.0001 absolute; it must also be at least frozen entry0.666753547526167 minus0.0001. This is a pragmatic study tolerance, not a statistical noninferiority conclusion. Control should reproduce parent AUC0.6671410169523699; unexplained drift invalidates matched attribution pending a charged diagnostic.

Predeclared utility rule: quality passes, model-only whole-batch p50 decreases by at least1% versus contemporary control, p95 increases by no more than1%, and full-validation inference seconds do not increase. Report all metrics even if criteria disagree. Smaller wall time alone does not suffice; one timing observation remains provisional.

Host should measure unchanged total/dense/embedding parameter counts32108245/315029/31793216 and equal training exposure. Training loss trajectory, learned state and running buffers should match the byte-identical reference under the frozen deterministic recipe. No training speedup is predicted; any such difference is timing noise until explained.

Affine-only and Dice-only effects may differ because launch savings and packing costs differ. Compute interaction for latency as both-affine-dice+reference in the same units; do not infer additivity from one combined winner. Report per-task AUC/Logloss, mean/auxiliary AUC separately, train/wall time, peak memory, throughput and p50/p95. Auxiliary tasks are already substantially weaker than baseline-din; disclose that limitation rather than infer joint-task superiority from click selection.

Before interpreting training/scoring, host numerical checks should compare source-identical state initialization, finite four [B,1] probability outputs, full/remainder/one/empty-history cases, masked-ID invariance, original task-label order, unchanged auxiliary gradients and support buffer ownership. Eval batching must not mutate buffers. Real-arithmetic equivalence does not imply BF16 bit equality. Local jail has no torch and cannot establish these checks.
falsifiers: Click AUC loss beyond0.0001 against contemporary control, failure against the entry floor, nonfinite predictions, wrong task order or a mask/information-boundary violation rejects a candidate.

No measured prediction-cost improvement under the predeclared latency/inference rule rejects utility for this implementation even if AUC improves. Packing can fail without refuting all scheduling optimizations.

Changed parameter/state keys, initialization/RNG, training computations or buffers, tied task weights, training-mode batch_norm or persistent derived caches falsify the intended isolated implementation comparison.

Failure of the contemporary reference to reproduce known quality, or unresolved runtime/clock/state discrepancies, blocks causal interpretation. No nonexistent failed receipt or missing execution is treated as scientific counterevidence.
alternative_explanations: Packing and temporary weight/statistic copies can outweigh reduced kernel dispatch; extra live task features can increase inference memory
Different BF16 GEMM shapes and BatchNorm channel layout may change rounding and ranking even though functions coincide in real arithmetic
GPU clocks, loading and scheduling affect latency; one fixed seed and one timed run do not establish repeated support
Across-round latency is not a matched contrast; interpretation requires the contemporary byte-identical control

Deterministic fixed-seed replay is a reproduction check, not an independent random-initialization repetition. Selection over many validation variants may overfit validation; withheld assessment stays closed.
Any accuracy change can arise from arithmetic rounding rather than additional useful information. Learned capacity and representation are explicitly unchanged.

The framework source and DIN primary text verify provenance; they do not establish local benefit. Latest knowledge-use assessments were reviewed, but inherited industry-card claims were not independently revalidated this round.
